newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Hongkong Bank in Mauritius reports growth in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank in Mauritius reports growth in 1996.

text.p: The Hongkong Bank (Mauritius) has reported a 39 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 157 million rupees ($7.68 million) for the year ended 31 December 1996 from 112.8 million rupees in 1995.

Interest income went up to 528.96 million rupees for the year ended 31 December 1996 from 427.87 million rupees in 1995, the bank's officials said. Profit after taxation climbed to 104.47 million rupees for 1996 from 75.39 million rupees for 1995.
Deposits totalled 4.39 billion rupees at end-1996 from 3.87 billion rupees one year earlier.
Hongkong's offshore banking's unit net profit rose by 29 percent to 73.54 million rupees 1996 from 57.20 million rupees in 1995.
Hongkong Bank operates 11 full service branches and an offshore banking unit in Mauritius, and is a subsidiary of Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation (HSBC) Holdings Plc.
